design.north_star: Learn computations from available documents that improve fresh complete answers at worthwhile training and inference cost. Separate parameter-training benefit from generating reasoning at deployment.
design.question: Does single-model supervised reasoning before or after an answer improve evidence-clean real-document QA over source-matched direct-answer training?
design.scope: A mature-model supervised reference,not novel CoT architecture,emergence,from-scratch pretraining,RL,or a benchmarkTEST score. Prior is conventional full-trace CoT with plain-answer replay.

data.split: Fixed salted hash,complete input<=3072;held supporttext/title/originaldataset:seedIDs disjoint withinheld;held support absent from alltrainvisible evidence;exact composed questions unique. No selection on model outcomes.
data.evidence: All visible source paragraphs and titles supplied,including distractors;gold support/decomposition/answers/aliases are offline only.
data.trace: Complete canonical2–4-hop question/answer/citationtrace including root;all intermediate canonical answers occur in cited visible source paragraphs. Literalpresence is notsemanticentailment.

arms.qa_prior: Even pass:direct answerEOS;odd pass:full trace,Final answer,answerEOS
arms.qa_post: Even pass:direct answerEOS;odd pass:answerEOS,Post-answer reasoning,full traceEOS

training.reducer: Single XLA ZeRO1 optimizer step;no extra reduction
training.loss: Perexample0.5 meanCE over256 fixed uniformly sampled original source positions plus0.5 meanCE over complete supervised task. Mean over all32examples once;not union-token or full-source CE.
training.ordered_data: Four full seed-specific shuffled passes;same exact order and source positions in every arm within seed.
training.primary_checkpoint: Terminal256;no held checkpoint selection.128 fullcheckpoint is recovery/development only.

endpoints.primary_metric: Canonical-answer normalized exact match over all512questions;MuSiQue/SQuAD normalization. Whole designated answer field,not numeric substring or correct word anywhere.
secondary_metrics: Attributed mirror-alias EM/F1,clearly separate from canonical

training_benefit.gate: Pointgain>=0.03 and paired95%CI lower>0 in EACH seed separately.

extra_inference_benefit.gate: Pointgain>=0.03 and paired95%CI lower>0 in EACH seed;also qa_prior.prior minus matched qa_direct.direct>=0.03 and lower>0 each.

practical_gain_over_base.gate: To claim stronger solver than pretrained reference:pointgain>=0.03 and paired95%CI lower>0 EACH seed. Otherwise report supervised mode adaptation/local inference benefit only.

endpoints.source_quality: Report ordinary WikipediaNLL cost relative toB0 andmatched direct;do not inherit the0.03FineMath threshold or silently relabel V17. A new QA gain with a measured NLL cost remains a tradeoff,not broad pretraining improvement.
endpoints.uncertainty: 20,000 paired bootstrap draws over the512 evidence-disjoint held questions,seed2026101921;each data-order seed separately,checkpoint-conditional unadjusted95% intervals. No pooled seed CI. Support/seed disjointness does not prove semantic independence.

inference.policy: Single greedy,tokenizer-defined native support;no answer-aware selection or repairs
inference.precision: Qualified existing FP32 evaluator;BF16 training weights loaded exactly,own native references/cache checks per model
inference.parser: Direct:first nonempty outputline after suppliedAnswer. Prior:anchoredFinal answerfield caseinsensitive,answer on same/next nonempty line. Newline or sampled terminator closes answer;unterminated lengthcap unsupported. No gold matching during parsing. Every failure retained.
inference.baseline: Unchanged B0 in same direct/prior/empty modes plus fixed two-example conventional CoT reference using invented facts;no held examples or outcome-selected prompt.
inference.controls: Replay controls serialize complete generated trace text under the same recipient prompt/Final answer boundary;compare own_replay with cyclic next-item other_replay. No donor trimming,length matching or utility selection. Original single-stream prior is primary and separate from replay. Oracle includes root answer. Question-only removes all documents;bridge-removal replaces the annotated first-hop support text while preserving indices/titles. These controls diagnose evidence dependence,not perfect semantic causal isolation.
inference.cost: Equal caps are not equal FLOPs/latency. Count actual actions,full context tokens,extra forwards,all six training runs,teacher-label resources and checkpoint work.

required: CPU masks/loss/accumulation/native data and parser checks
Actual long-prefill FP32 cached/ordinary parity on disposable TRAIN
Frozen source/objective/order/metrics/controls before held model forwards
Verified latest-full protection and enough copy-new-full-FIRST space for all terminal models

design.stop_policy: Stop on nonfinite/wrongtargets/leakage/reducerfailure/corruptstate/unboundedmemory or explicitownerstop. Do not rush stable runs or select checkpoints by held scores. No automatic retry.
design.decision: Continue a method only if its declared endpoint succeeds against the source-matched control. If only CoT helps,retain ordinary CoT as reference. If only post helps,training scaffold value is separate. If neitherhelps,record negative and reconsider objective/data;do not relaunch the stopped RL recipe.
limits: Two data-order seeds do not estimate general training-seed uncertainty.
AuthorsTRAIN-derived research development,officialDEV/TEST unopened. Pretraining and semantic duplicates not ruled out.
Repeated answers,distractors and relation templates permitted.
Mirror-alias authenticity not independently verified against official ZIP;canonicalprimary avoids depending on that annotation.

ordinary_panel.limits: MuSiQue authorTRAIN source paragraphs,not officialDEV/TEST. Exactdisjointness doesnotestablishpretrainingorsemanticnovelty.

official_metric_check.limits: Code-onlydownload. No datasetDEV/TEST ormodeloutcomes. Only four reviewed purefunctions executed;not the repository evaluation loader.

ordinary_preselection_repair: Initial paragraph-hash sample repeated page titles and failed the declared unique-page check before writing data. V2 takes first paragraph perpage in fixed hash order. Original source/plan/failure retained;no model outcomes or endpoint changes.
active_qualifications: Training world8/3328 and FP32 decoding core56/3584 are active. Completion markers alone do not release scientific learning or held evaluation.

latest_prospective_design.reason: Give every trained arm the fixed conventional CoT demonstrations as well as its native mode. Require the augmented solver to beat the source-trained control with those demonstrations,so a missing learned output format cannot create an artificially weak baseline. Before any scientific training/held forwards;all existing primary endpoints/data/objectives unchanged.
